title: Pizza Dough
description: A simple pizza dough made from self-raising flour, low-fat Greek yoghurt and olive oil. Ready in under 10 minutes of mixing, then chilled before rolling.

ingredients.text: 210g self-raising flour, plus extra for dusting

steps: Sift the flour into a bowl, add the Greek yoghurt and olive oil. Mix with a wooden spoon until it starts to come together, then use your hands to form a smooth ball.
Knead on a floured surface for 5–10 minutes, adding flour if sticky. Refrigerate for at least an hour.
Preheat oven to 220°C/200°C fan with a baking tray or pizza stone inside.
Roll out on baking paper to a 0.5cm circle. Add toppings.
Slide on to the preheated tray/stone and cook for 25–30 minutes. Remove the tray for the last 10 minutes to crisp the base.
notes: Makes 1 large pizza (serves 4). For a dessert version, omit the olive oil and top with Nutella before baking.
